name: demo5_maths
code:
# Input and maths
n = int(input('Number?'))
total = 0
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    total = total + i
print('sum=' + str(total))
print('max=' + str(max(n, total)))
print('pow=' + str(pow(n, 3)))

name: demo6_slice
code:
# Search and slice
text = 'hello world'
pos = 0
for i in range(1, len(text) + 1):
    if text[i - 1] == ' ' :
        pos = i
print(pos)
print(text[:pos - 1])
print(text[pos:])

name: demo7_mixed
code:
# Mixed practice
a, b = 3, 4
print(pow(a, 2) + pow(b, 2))
s = 'abcdef'
i = len(s)
out = ''
while i > 0:
    out = out + s[i - 1]
    i = i - 1
print(out)
print('bye')
